title: DOVE PADDED HEAVY FLEECE TEE
description:
Background: Designed by Demna and his team, featuring a Dove designed by Alan Pastrana, the Dove Padded Heavy Fleece Tee was initially sold on Mythresa in Black, Dark Grey, and Beige. It later dropped on yeezygap.com in just Black. 

Dark Grey and Beige were third-party exclusives. In an interview with CNBC on 09/15/2022, Ye said that there were colorways he hadn't approved, as well as sites.

The initial Stock Images were used on Mythresa, and Gap would then use updated Stock Images. A shiny logo, Stock Image, and side Model Images were used exclusively on Balenciaga.com.

The Tee features the GAP logo arch on the front and the Dove on the back with removable shoulder pads.

Release Dates: 05/27/2022, on Mythresa.com and 09/09/2022, on yeezygap.com

title: Concert Boot
description:
Background: This boot was worn by Ye for all his 2025 concert appearances.

The boot can also be spotted in various Yeezy.com looks. 

On 04/07/2026, Aus Taylor made a personal Instagram page public with a picture of Ye and Bianca he posted on 08/27/2025, with Ye wearing a cream-colored Boot.

On 07/14/2026, an image of a rack of Yeezy samples leaked, showing white, dark grey, and brown colorways.

Documented wear by Ye:
• 07/12/2025 during his Shanghai concert
• 07/26/2025 during his Incheon concert
• 08/27/2025 
• 11/08/2025 during Travis Scott's CIRCUS MAXIMUS Belluna Dome Show Tokyo, Japan
• 01/31/2026 during Day 2 of his "YE LIVE IN MEXICO CITY" concert

title: Logan Run Boot
description: Background: Designed by Nick Daiber & Strah, nicknamed after the sci/fi novel and film "Logan's Run," the foam hiker boot was initially one of many foam footwear concepts made by the Yeezy team in Wyoming. However, of all the concepts, apart from the foam runner, this boot saw the most development with "over 50" (per @archiving.ideas) colorways and multiple versions. The mold of the sole for the boot was even brought back for experimenting in Yeezy Season 9 footwear.
